qti-content-body.p: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.

Rather than the experimental jazz playing on the festival's main stage, this smaller stage featured _____ folk songs passed down for generations among Appalachian families, using melodies well over a century old.

Correct! Traditional specifically fits music passed down through generations of a community's own cultural practice, which matches Appalachian folk songs handed down for generations. Classical specifically implies a formal style tied to European art-music standards, which doesn't fit vernacular folk songs at all. Conventional describes following ordinary norms generally, without traditional's specific sense of generational cultural inheritance, and time-honored leans more toward emphasizing earned respect than simple generational transmission. Traditional means long-established as part of a culture's customs, beliefs, or practices, typically passed down from one generation to the next.
